decisions.reason: It builds closely on the firm's existing encryption and communication software knowledge, allowing effective learning from early results.
The multi-layer security architecture directly exploits the firm's core security consulting and software design expertise, so absorptive capacity is high.
A hardware signature token requires manufacturing and hardware development capabilities far from the firm's core software and consultancy knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve.
Payment network security compliance builds on the firm's existing regulatory and security consultancy knowledge, enabling it to interpret results and refine the suite.
